name: Transportation Almanac
description: An open, versioned index of public transportation data.

entries.title: BTS Airline On-Time Performance Statistics
entries.description: Flight-level on-time arrival and departure, delay cause, cancellation, and diversion data reported by large U.S. air carriers, published by the Bureau of Transportation Statistics through TranStats.
entries.publisher: U.S. Department of Transportation, Bureau of Transportation Statistics (BTS)

coverage.spatial: United States (domestic flights of reporting carriers)
coverage.temporal: January 1995 through August 2026 (as stated on the page)

entries.attribution: Bureau of Transportation Statistics, Airline On-Time Statistics
entries.notes: Human-verified 2026-10-31: HTTP 200. The page states "Data are available from January 1995 through August 2026" and documents carrier merger reporting changes. Three things come from TranStats' usual practice and weren't checked here: flight-level detail, the monthly cadence, and CSV downloads. TranStats (https://www.transtats.bts.gov/) is reachable, but several www.bts.gov pages, such as the Freight Analysis Framework, returned Access Denied to both curl and headless Chromium this session.

entries.title: UNCTADstat
entries.description: UN Trade and Development's statistical database covering maritime transport, merchant fleets, liner shipping connectivity, and freight volumes alongside its broader trade and economy indicators.
entries.publisher: United Nations Conference on Trade and Development (UNCTAD)
entries.notes: Verified reachable this session (HTTP 200). ITF-OECD (International Transport Forum), the other natural international transport-statistics body, returned a Cloudflare bot-challenge on direct fetch — same block class as almanac-template#2. Seeded as this vertical's first international (non-US) source per operator request to seed the new verticals international-first.
